workflow_name: Expenses document date for later period v/s posting date in previous period / qtr
workflow_description: Flag line items where Document Date falls in a later accounting month-year than Posting Date, including across years, indicating potential timing irregularities.
business_logic_plan: Business Logic Plan: Expenses document date for later period v/s posting date in previous period / qtr 1) Objective - Flag and extract all FBL3N line items where the Document Date falls in a later accounting month-year than the Posting Date (gap of 1+ months, including across years). - Provide severity buckets by month difference and fiscal quarter labels (Apr–Mar) for context. - Output one row per original line item (no aggregation), containing identification, business logic, context, and calculated fields. 2) Data Source - Input file: data/uploads/79236429-147c-4ccb-8002-25ef40acbf10/FBL3N.csv - Relevant input columns available: - Document Date - Posting Date - Company Code - Document Number - G/L Account - Cost Center - Profit Center - Document Type - Amount in local currency - Local Currency - Amount in doc. curr. - Document currency - Text - Document Header Text - Reference - User Name - Entry Date - G/L Acct Long Text.1 3) In-Scope Records and Filters - Include all line items in FBL3N (no pre-filtering by account, type, or amount). - Flagging is based solely on the Document Date vs Posting Date month-year comparison. - Output will contain flagged records only (rows where Document month-year > Posting month-year). 4) Business Rules - Exception condition: - A line item is flagged if Document month-year is later than Posting month-year. - Differences across calendar years are included (e.g., Posting 2023-12, Document 2024-01 is flagged). - Month difference (Months Difference): - Compute integer months difference as: - Months Difference = (Document Year × 12 + Document Month) − (Posting Year × 12 + Posting Month) - Only retain rows with Months Difference >= 1. - Severity Bucket (based on Months Difference): - 1 month - 2–3 months - 4–6 months - >6 months - Fiscal Quarter labels (Apr–Mar): - Fiscal quarters: - Q1: Apr–Jun - Q2: Jul–Sep - Q3: Oct–Dec - Q4: Jan–Mar - Derive and attach labels for both Posting FY Quarter and Document FY Quarter for context (no special exclusions by quarter). 5) Derived Fields - Posting Month-Year: posting month-year value derived from Posting Date. - Document Month-Year: document month-year value derived from Document Date. - Months Difference: integer month difference (Document − Posting months). - Severity Bucket: categorical label using the above bands. - Posting FY Quarter: quarter label for Posting Date using Apr–Mar fiscal year. - Document FY Quarter: quarter label for Document Date using Apr–Mar fiscal year. 6) Processing Steps - Step 1: Read FBL3N.csv. - Step 2: From Posting Date and Document Date, derive: - Posting Month-Year (e.g., YYYY-MM) - Document Month-Year (e.g., YYYY-MM) - Posting Year, Posting Month - Document Year, Document Month - Step 3: Compute Months Difference: - months_post = Posting Year × 12 + Posting Month - months_doc = Document Year × 12 + Document Month - Months Difference = months_doc − months_post - Step 4: Apply exception condition: - Flag rows where Months Difference >= 1. - Step 5: Assign Severity Bucket: - If Months Difference == 1 → "1 month" - If Months Difference in [2, 3] → "2–3 months" - If Months Difference in [4, 5, 6] → "4–6 months" - If Months Difference > 6 → ">6 months" - Step 6: Fiscal quarter labeling (Apr–Mar): - For Posting Date and Document Date separately: - If Month in [4,5,6] → Q1 - If Month in [7,8,9] → Q2 - If Month in [10,11,12] → Q3 - If Month in [1,2,3] → Q4 - Output as Posting FY Quarter and Document FY Quarter labels. - Step 7: Filter to flagged exceptions only (Months Difference >= 1). - Step 8: Select and order output columns as defined below. - Step 9: Optional sorting for review (recommended): sort by Company Code, Posting Date ascending, then Months Difference descending. 7) Output CSV Columns - Identification Columns: - Company Code - Document Number - G/L Account - Cost Center - Profit Center - Business Logic Columns: - Document Date - Posting Date - Document Type - Context Columns: - Amount in local currency - Local Currency - Amount in doc. curr. - Document currency - Text - Document Header Text - Reference - User Name - Entry Date - G/L Acct Long Text.1 - Calculated Columns: - Posting Month-Year - Document Month-Year - Months Difference - Severity Bucket - Posting FY Quarter - Document FY Quarter 8) Inclusion/Exclusion Rules - Include: All line items in FBL3N that meet the exception condition (Months Difference >= 1). - Exclude: None beyond the exception condition (no document type, account, or amount exclusions). 9) Edge Case Handling - Document month-year equals Posting month-year → not flagged. - Document month-year earlier than Posting month-year → not flagged. - Differences across calendar/fiscal years are flagged based solely on months difference. - The fiscal quarter labels are provided for context even if the months difference is 1 and may or may not cross quarters. 10) Example Logic Outline - Compute year and month components from Posting Date and Document Date. - months_post = (posting_year × 12) + posting_month - months_doc = (document_year × 12) + document_month - months_diff = months_doc − months_post - Keep rows where months_diff >= 1 - Map months_diff to Severity Bucket: - 1 → "1 month" - 2–3 → "2–3 months" - 4–6 → "4–6 months" - >6 → ">6 months" - Derive Posting FY Quarter and Document FY Quarter using Apr–Mar definition. 11) Acceptance Criteria - The output CSV contains only records where Document Month-Year is later than Posting Month-Year. - Each output row represents the original line item (no aggregation). - All specified identification, logic, context, and calculated columns are present. - Severity Bucket and both FY Quarter labels are populated for each flagged row. 12) Deliverable - A single CSV file containing all flagged exceptions with the columns and derivations specified above, suitable for review of timing irregularities.
